how: tools/probe_agents.py <role> run against a COPY of the SLAI checkout (never the live repository), through SLAI's own AgentFactory.

machines.device: the person's computer (Linux VM of the desktop app): Python 3.10, no torch, no joblib
machines.cloud: development container: Python 3.13, SLAI checkout mirror; the agents were not probed there

reader.result: capabilities() answered (modes: capabilities, compress, convert, decompress, describe, detect, jobs, merge, parse, pipeline, read, recover, resume, salvage, validate, ...)
reader.note: Documaster calls the Reader ENGINES (parser, detector, integrity, compression) directly, not the ReaderAgent.

privacy.result: register_consent and bind_purpose accepted; evaluate_privacy answered decision 'modify' for text containing an email address, phone number and IBAN, with a sanitised payload in which the whole content is replaced by a token; without a registered consent it raises ConsentArtifactMissingError (PRV-3007).
privacy.note: Documaster therefore registers the person's consent first, and treats 'modify' as: do not forward the text.

handler.result: failure_normalization answered schema handler.failure.v2 with type, category, severity, retryable, policy_action.
handler.note: Only used when telemetry is switched on (off by default).

observability.result: perform_task accepted a latency/event record and returned a trace (status 'degraded', incident_level 'critical' for a single 120 ms sample: Documaster does not interpret this).
observability.note: Only used when telemetry is switched on (off by default).

language.result: Could not be loaded: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'torch'.
language.note: Documaster's use of it (classify_text, rerank_texts, summarize_text) is written against the agent's methods but has NOT been run against the real agent.

safety.result: Could not be loaded: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'torch'.
safety.note: Documaster's use of it (perform_task on document text) has NOT been run against the real agent.

quality.result: Could not be initialised: SQLite Quality Memory missing (quality_memory.sqlite3); its migration script was not in the checkout copy.

planning.result: Could not be loaded: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'joblib'.
planning.note: Not used by design: Documaster's steps have fixed dependencies, so there is nothing to plan.
